items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: They got my picture, Albert Burbank, too. I played with him once.

ctx.x: They got my picture, Albert Burbank, too. I played with him once. Albert Burbank's sheet. There was a bunch of us. They took our picture. Some of them down at the Green Hall. Because Albert told me he had my picture. Which hall was that? It's a Green Hall, way down Gentilly. I don't know that then. There was two people down there taking pictures. I guess they must have worked with you.
I don't remember that hall. I remember one hall way down there on Law Street or something.
